_comment: Dashboard form for FAM-003. Read by studio/dashboard/dashboard.py; flags must match make.py's argparse. '@themes' is expanded from studio/themes/. This product fetches nothing, so it has no recall block.

schema.label: Inside size (mm)
schema.help: Width x height x depth of the shelf opening. 330x330x390 is IKEA Kallax. Measure the opening, not the outside of the unit.

schema.label: Depth covered (mm)
schema.help: How far forward the floor and walls reach. Stopping 30 mm short hides behind the shelf lip and saves a sheet.

schema.label: Print the ceiling
schema.help: Adds a fifth face. It is unlit and barely seen. It costs 2 more sheets on A4 and 3 on Letter.

schema.label: Theme
schema.help: The shop theme the room is drawn in. Room colours are derived from the theme palette.

schema.label: Paper
schema.help: Home paper only. 'both' writes one PDF per paper size into the same bundle.

schema.label: Easy print mode
schema.help: One panel per sheet. 16 sheets instead of 11, but no sheet holds two panels.

schema.label: Write PNG preview
schema.help: Needed to show thumbnails on this dashboard.
